items.title: IREN (IREN) Draws Tighter Oversight On Neocloud Data Center Projects
items.summary: Microsoft has tightened oversight of neocloud data center projects with partner IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) after recent delivery issues. The tech giant has declined contract extensions on certain neocloud builds, citing project delays and higher than expected costs. IREN is reported to have faced operational setbacks at its Texas facility, including an incident that disrupted local data center activity.
